title: Agent adapter discovery and capabilities
objective: Detect supported Agent candidates with confidence and expose verified install targets and capabilities without treating unknown capability as supported.
acceptance_criteria: Detection distinguishes confirmed, probable, unknown, and not_found.
Only confirmed or explicitly selected probable targets can be modified.
Capabilities distinguish true/false/unknown; unknown is unsupported for execution decisions.
undo_classification: Revert adapter code/docs introduced by this node only.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; repeated identical failure escalates.
